name: pm-skills
title_zh: 把产品经理的68个最佳实践打包成AI可用的技能
tagline_zh: 别让AI只会写周报。装上这套技能，你的Agent能跑完三钻石流程、设计冲刺，产出200+份带格式的交付物。
tagline_en: Stop your AI from just writing status reports. With 68 PM skills, your agent runs Triple Diamond phases, Design.
desc_en: 68 plug-and-play, best-practice product management skills for AI agents: 30 Triple Diamond phase + 11 foundation + 12 utility + 15 tool (Foundation Sprint + Design Sprint). Plus 6 sub-agents, workflows, 200+ output samples, guides, and CI-enforced contracts. Apache 2.0.
why_zh: 不是零散提示词，而是CI强制校验的契约式技能包：每个阶段有输入输出定义、样本和失败兜底。
why_en: Not scattered prompts—contract-enforced skills with CI checks, I/O specs, samples, and fallbacks. Predictable, reusable.
limit_zh: 只覆盖产品管理域（发现/定义/交付），不碰代码生成或数据分析。需要Agent支持YAML/JSON契约解析。
limit_en: PM domain only (discover/define/deliver)—no codegen or data analysis. Requires agent YAML/JSON contract parsing; if you don't use Triple Diamond.
